'''Sevron Ta''' was the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] owner of [[Ta's Roost]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Zone Three]] in [[Gallisport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]]. Ta always made sure there was a table available for the use of the [[Rabid Mynocks]], a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] that protected the area.
